He was hurled down, the great dragon, the ancient serpent, called the devil and Satan, the one who leads the whole world astray; he was hurled down to the earth, and his angels with him.

And I heard a loud voice in heaven saying: "Now have come the salvation, the power, and the reign of our God, and the authority of his Christ; for he has been hurled down, the accuser of our brothers, the one who accuses them day and night before our God.
They have conquered him by the blood of the Lamb and by the word to which they bore witness; they did not cling to their lives even in the face of death.
Rejoice then, O heavens, and you who dwell in them! Woe to the earth and the sea, for the devil has come down to you, filled with great fury, knowing that his time is short."
When the dragon saw that he had been hurled down to the earth, he pursued the woman who had given birth to the male child.

But the two wings of the great eagle were given to the woman, so that she might fly into the wilderness, to her refuge, where she is nourished for a time, two times, and half a time, far from the serpent.
From its mouth the serpent spewed water like a river behind the woman, to sweep her away in its flood.
But the earth came to the woman's aid: it opened its mouth and swallowed the river that the dragon had spewed from its mouth.
Furious with the woman, the dragon went off to make war on the rest of her children, on those who keep the commandments of God and hold to the testimony of Jesus.
And it stood on the sand of the sea.
Then I saw a beast rising out of the sea, with ten horns and seven heads; on its horns, ten diadems, and on its heads, blasphemous names.
The beast that I saw resembled a leopard; its feet were like those of a bear, and its mouth like the mouth of a lion. The dragon gave it its power, its throne, and great authority.
One of its heads seemed wounded to death, but its mortal wound was healed. Then the whole earth, marveling, followed the beast;
and they worshiped the dragon, who had given authority to the beast, and they worshiped the beast, saying: "Who is like the beast, and who can make war against it?"
It was given a mouth that uttered arrogant and blasphemous words, and the power to act for forty-two months.
It opened its mouth to blaspheme God, to blaspheme his name, his Dwelling, and those who dwell in heaven.
It was allowed to make war on the saints and to conquer them, and it was given authority over every tribe, every people, every tongue, and every nation.
All the inhabitants of the earth will worship it, those whose name is not written, since the foundation of the world, in the book of life of the Lamb who was slain.
Let whoever has ears listen.
If anyone is destined for captivity, into captivity he will go; if anyone is to perish by the sword, by the sword he will perish. Here is the perseverance and the faith of the saints.
Then I saw another beast rising out of the earth; it had two horns like a lamb, but it spoke like a dragon.
It exercised all the authority of the first beast, in its sight, and made the earth and its inhabitants worship the first beast, whose mortal wound had been healed.
It performed great wonders, even making fire come down from heaven to the earth before the eyes of men.

It led the inhabitants of the earth astray by the wonders it was allowed to perform before the beast, persuading them to set up an image in honor of the beast that, wounded by the sword, had come back to life.
It was allowed to give breath to the image of the beast, so that the image might speak and have all who would not worship the image of the beast put to death.
And it forced everyone, small and great, rich and poor, free and slave, to receive a mark on the right hand or on the forehead,
so that no one could buy or sell except the one who bears the mark, the name of the beast or the number of its name.
Here is wisdom. Let whoever has understanding calculate the number of the beast, for it is the number of a man, and its number is six hundred and sixty-six.

titres.titre: The Lamb and the Hundred and Forty-Four Thousand
The Harvest and the Vintage of the Earth

versets.t: Then I saw: the Lamb was standing on Mount Zion, and with him a hundred and forty-four thousand people, bearing his name and the name of his Father written on their foreheads.
And I heard a sound coming from heaven, like the voice of many waters and the rumbling of a mighty thunder; the sound that I heard was like that of harpists playing on their harps.
They sing a new song before the throne, before the four living creatures and the Elders. And no one could learn that song except the hundred and forty-four thousand redeemed from the earth.

These are the ones who have not defiled themselves with women; they are virgins. These are the ones who follow the Lamb wherever he goes. They have been redeemed from among men, as firstfruits for God and for the Lamb,
and no lie was found in their mouth: they are without blame.
Then I saw another angel flying in midheaven, holding an eternal Good News to proclaim to the inhabitants of the earth, to every nation, tribe, tongue, and people.
He said in a loud voice: "Fear God and give him glory, for the hour of his judgment has come; worship the one who made heaven and earth, the sea and the springs of water."
Another angel, a second, followed, saying: "Fallen, fallen is Babylon the great, who made all the nations drink the wine of the fury of her debauchery."
Another angel, a third, followed them, saying in a loud voice: "If anyone worships the beast and its image, and receives its mark on the forehead or on the hand,
he too will drink of the wine of the fury of God, poured undiluted into the cup of his wrath, and he will be tormented with fire and sulfur, before the holy angels and before the Lamb.
The smoke of their torment rises for ever and ever; they have no rest, day or night, those who worship the beast and its image, and whoever receives the mark of its name."
Here is the perseverance of the saints, who keep the commandments of God and the faith in Jesus.
And I heard a voice coming from heaven, saying: "Write: Blessed, from now on, are the dead who die in the Lord! Yes, says the Spirit, let them rest from their labors, for their works follow them."
Then I saw: a white cloud, and on the cloud was seated one like a son of man, a crown of gold on his head and a sharp sickle in his hand.
Another angel came out of the sanctuary, crying in a loud voice to the one seated on the cloud: "Put in your sickle and reap, for the hour to reap has come: the harvest of the earth is ripe."
Then the one seated on the cloud swung his sickle over the earth, and the earth was harvested.
Another angel came out of the sanctuary that is in heaven, holding a sharp sickle as well.

And another angel, the one who has authority over fire, came out from the altar and cried in a loud voice to the one who held the sharp sickle: "Put in your sharp sickle and gather the clusters of the vine of the earth, for its grapes are ripe."
The angel swung his sickle over the earth, gathered the vine of the earth, and threw its clusters into the great winepress of the wrath of God.
The winepress was trodden outside the city, and from it came blood that rose as high as the horses' bridles, over a distance of about three hundred kilometers.

titres.titre: The Song of Moses and of the Lamb

versets.t: Then I saw in heaven another sign, great and astonishing: seven angels bearing the seven last plagues, for with them the wrath of God is brought to completion.

And I saw what looked like a sea of glass mixed with fire, and standing beside this sea were those who had triumphed over the beast, over its image, and over the number of its name; they held the harps of God.
They were singing the song of Moses, the servant of God, and the song of the Lamb: "Great and marvelous are your works, Lord God Almighty! Just and true are your ways, King of the nations!
Who would not fear you, Lord, and give glory to your name? For you alone are holy. All the nations will come and bow down before you, for your judgments have been revealed."
After this I saw the sanctuary of the tent of the Testimony open in heaven.
And the seven angels who bear the seven plagues came out of the sanctuary, clothed in pure and gleaming linen, with a golden sash around their chests.
One of the four living creatures gave the seven angels seven golden bowls, full of the wrath of the God who lives forever and ever.
And the sanctuary was filled with the smoke of the glory of God and of his power; no one could enter the sanctuary until the seven plagues of the seven angels were brought to completion.
And I heard, coming from the sanctuary, a loud voice that said to the seven angels: "Go and pour out upon the earth the seven bowls of the wrath of God."
The first went and poured out his bowl upon the earth; and a foul and painful sore struck the people who bore the mark of the beast and who worshiped its image.
The second poured out his bowl into the sea: it became like the blood of a dead man, and every living thing in the sea died.
The third poured out his bowl into the rivers and the springs: the waters became blood.
And I heard the angel of the waters say: "You are just, you who are and who were, the Holy One, in passing this judgment.
Because they shed the blood of the saints and the prophets, you have given them blood to drink: they deserve it."
And I heard the altar say: "Yes, Lord God Almighty, your judgments are true and just."
The fourth poured out his bowl upon the sun, and it was given power to scorch people with fire;
the people were scorched by intense heat, and they blasphemed the name of God, who has authority over these plagues, yet they did not repent and give him glory.
The fifth poured out his bowl upon the throne of the beast, and its kingdom was plunged into darkness; people bit their tongues in pain,
and they blasphemed the God of heaven because of their pains and their sores, yet they did not repent of their deeds.
The sixth poured out his bowl upon the great river, the Euphrates, and its waters dried up, to open the way for the kings from the east.
And I saw coming out of the mouth of the dragon, out of the mouth of the beast, and out of the mouth of the false prophet three unclean spirits, like frogs.
These are the spirits of demons, who work wonders; they go out to the kings of the whole earth, to gather them for the battle of the great day of God the Almighty.
"Behold, I am coming like a thief! Blessed is the one who stays awake and keeps his garments, so as not to go about naked and let his shame be seen."
And they gathered them at the place called, in Hebrew, Armageddon.
The seventh poured out his bowl into the air; and from the sanctuary, from the throne, a loud voice came out, saying: "It is done."
Then there were flashes of lightning, voices, peals of thunder, and a great earthquake, such as had never occurred since man has been on the earth, so violent was it.
The great city split into three parts, and the cities of the nations collapsed. God remembered Babylon the Great, to make her drink the cup of the wine of his fierce wrath.
Every island fled, and the mountains could no longer be found.
And enormous hailstones, each weighing about forty kilos, fell from the sky upon the people; and the people blasphemed God because of the plague of hail, for this plague was terrible.

titres.titre: Babylon the Great, the Great Prostitute

versets.t: Then one of the seven angels who held the seven bowls came and said to me: "Come, I will show you the judgment of the great prostitute, who is seated beside the great waters;
with her the kings of the earth have given themselves over to immorality, and the inhabitants of the earth have become drunk with the wine of her immorality."
He carried me away into the wilderness, in the Spirit. And I saw a woman seated on a scarlet beast, covered with blasphemous names, with seven heads and ten horns.
The woman was clothed in purple and scarlet, adorned with gold, precious stones, and pearls; in her hand she held a golden cup, filled with abominations and the impurities of her immorality.
On her forehead was written a name, a mystery: "Babylon the Great, the mother of prostitutes and of the abominations of the earth."
And I saw the woman drunk with the blood of the saints and with the blood of the witnesses of Jesus. At the sight of her, I was seized with great astonishment.
The angel said to me: "Why are you astonished? I will tell you the mystery of the woman and of the beast that carries her, the one with the seven heads and the ten horns.

The beast that you saw was and is no more; it is about to come up from the abyss and go to its destruction. The inhabitants of the earth, those whose name is not written in the book of life from the foundation of the world, will be astonished when they see the beast, because it was, it is no more, and it will reappear.
Here is where wisdom and understanding are needed. The seven heads are seven mountains, on which the woman is seated. They are also seven kings:
five have fallen, one is here, the other has not yet come; and when he comes, he must remain only a little while.
The beast that was and is no more, it is an eighth king, and yet it is one of the seven, and it goes to its destruction.
The ten horns that you saw are ten kings who have not yet received a kingdom, but who receive, for one hour, royal power along with the beast.
They have but one purpose, and they put their power and their authority at the service of the beast.
They will make war on the Lamb, but the Lamb will conquer them, for he is Lord of lords and King of kings; and those who are with him, the called, the chosen, the faithful, will conquer as well."
And he said to me: "The waters that you saw, where the prostitute is enthroned, are peoples and crowds, nations and tongues.
And the ten horns that you saw, together with the beast, will hate the prostitute; they will strip her and leave her naked, devour her flesh, and consume her with fire.
For God has put it into their hearts to carry out his purpose, to act with one accord and to give their kingdom to the beast, until the words of God are fulfilled.
And the woman that you saw is the great city that reigns over the kings of the earth."
After this I saw another angel coming down from heaven, holding great authority, and the earth was lit up with his glory.
He cried out in a mighty voice: "Fallen, fallen is Babylon the great! She has become a dwelling of demons, a haunt of every unclean spirit, a haunt of every unclean and detestable bird,

for all the nations have drunk the wine of the fury of her immorality; the kings of the earth have committed immorality with her, and the merchants of the earth have grown rich from the excess of her luxury."
And I heard another voice from heaven say: "Come out of her, my people, so that you take no part in her sins and are not struck by her plagues,
for her sins are piled as high as heaven, and God has remembered her injustices.
Pay her back as she herself has paid, repay her double for her deeds; in the cup she has mixed, mix her a double portion;
as much as she has glorified herself and wallowed in luxury, so much give her of torment and grief. For she says in her heart: I sit enthroned as a queen, I am no widow, and I will never know grief.
That is why, in a single day, her plagues will fall upon her: death and grief and famine, and she will be consumed by fire; for mighty is the Lord God who has judged her."
The kings of the earth, who committed immorality and lived in luxury with her, will weep and mourn over her when they see the smoke of her burning.
Standing at a distance for fear of her torment, they will say: "Alas, alas, great city, Babylon, mighty city! In a single hour your judgment has come."
The merchants of the earth weep and mourn over her, for no one buys their cargo anymore:

cargo of gold and silver, precious stones and pearls, fine linen and purple, silk and scarlet; every kind of fragrant wood, every article of ivory, every article of costly wood, of bronze, iron and marble;
cinnamon and spice, perfumes, myrrh and incense, wine and oil, fine flour and wheat; beasts of burden and sheep, horses and chariots, and the bodies and souls of men.
The fruit your soul craved has gone from you; all that was splendor and magnificence is lost to you, and it will never be found again.
The merchants of these goods, who grew rich from her, will stand at a distance for fear of her torment; they will weep and mourn,
saying: "Alas, alas, great city, clothed in fine linen, purple and scarlet, adorned with gold, precious stones and pearls! In a single hour such wealth has been laid waste."
And every pilot, everyone who sails to a port, the sailors and all who make their living from the sea stood at a distance
and cried out as they saw the smoke of her burning: "What city was like the great city?"
They threw dust on their heads, crying out, weeping and mourning: "Alas, alas, great city, whose opulence enriched all who had ships on the sea! In a single hour she has been laid waste."
Rejoice over her, heaven, and you saints, apostles and prophets, for in judging her God has given you justice.
Then a mighty angel took a stone, like a great millstone, and threw it into the sea, saying: "So, with one blow, will Babylon the great city be cast down, and it will never be found again.

The sound of harpists and musicians, of flute players and trumpeters, will never be heard in you again; no craftsman of any trade will ever be found in you again; the noise of the millstone will never be heard in you again;

the light of the lamp will never shine in you again; the voice of the bridegroom and the bride will never be heard in you again. For your merchants were the great ones of the earth, and all the nations were led astray by your sorcery.
And in her was found the blood of the prophets and the saints and all who have been slaughtered on the earth."

titres.titre: The Alleluia of heaven and the wedding of the Lamb

versets.t: After this I heard what sounded like a great voice, that of an immense crowd in heaven, saying: "Alleluia! Salvation and glory and power belong to our God,
for his judgments are true and just: he has judged the great prostitute who corrupted the earth with her immorality, and he has avenged on her the blood of his servants."
And a second time they said: "Alleluia! The smoke of her burning rises for ever and ever."
Then the twenty-four elders and the four living creatures fell down and worshiped God, seated on the throne, saying: "Amen! Alleluia!"
And from the throne came a voice that said: "Praise our God, all you his servants, you who fear him, small and great!"
And I heard what sounded like the voice of an immense crowd, like the voice of many waters, like the roar of mighty thunder, saying: "Alleluia! The Lord our God, the Almighty, reigns.
Let us rejoice and be glad and give him glory, for the wedding of the Lamb has come, and his bride has made herself ready;
she has been granted to clothe herself in fine linen, bright and pure." This fine linen is the righteous deeds of the saints.
Then the angel said to me: "Write: Blessed are those who are invited to the wedding feast of the Lamb." And he added: "These are the true words of God."

I fell at his feet to worship him, but he said to me: "Do not do that! I am a servant like you and like your brothers who hold the testimony of Jesus. Worship God!" For the testimony of Jesus is the spirit of prophecy.
Then I saw heaven opened, and there appeared a white horse; the one who rode it is called Faithful and True, and it is with justice that he judges and makes war.
His eyes were a flame of fire, on his head were many diadems, and he had a name written that no one knows but himself.
He was clothed in a cloak soaked in blood, and his name is: the Word of God.
The armies of heaven followed him on white horses, clothed in fine linen, white and pure.
From his mouth comes a sharp sword to strike the nations; he is the one who will rule them with a rod of iron, and he treads the winepress of the fierce wrath of God the Almighty.
On his cloak and on his thigh he bears a name written: King of kings and Lord of lords.
And I saw an angel standing in the sun; he cried out in a loud voice to all the birds flying in midheaven: "Come, gather for the great feast of God,
to eat the flesh of kings, the flesh of commanders, the flesh of the mighty, the flesh of horses and their riders, the flesh of all, free and slave, small and great."
And I saw the beast, the kings of the earth and their armies, gathered to make war against the rider and his army.

The beast was captured, and with it the false prophet, who had worked before it the signs by which he had led astray those who bore the mark of the beast and worshiped its image. Both were thrown alive into the lake of fire blazing with sulfur.
The rest were killed by the sword that came from the mouth of the rider, and all the birds gorged themselves on their flesh.

titres.titre: The thousand-year reign and the last judgment

versets.t: Then I saw an angel coming down from heaven, holding in his hand the key to the abyss and a great chain.
He seized the dragon, the ancient serpent, who is the devil and Satan, and bound him for a thousand years.

He threw him into the abyss, which he shut and sealed over him, so that he would no longer lead the nations astray until the thousand years were completed. After that he must be released for a little while.

Then I saw thrones: to those who sat on them it was given to judge. And I saw the souls of those who had been beheaded for the testimony of Jesus and for the word of God, those who had not worshiped the beast or its image and had not received its mark on their forehead or on their hand. They came to life and reigned with Christ for a thousand years.
The rest of the dead did not come to life until the thousand years were completed. This is the first resurrection.

Blessed and holy is the one who has part in the first resurrection! Over them the second death has no power; they will be priests of God and of Christ, and they will reign with him for a thousand years.
When the thousand years are completed, Satan will be released from his prison;
he will go out to lead astray the nations at the four corners of the earth, Gog and Magog, and to gather them for battle; their number is like the sand of the sea.
They marched up over the whole breadth of the earth and surrounded the camp of the saints and the beloved city; but fire came down from heaven and devoured them.
And the devil, who led them astray, was thrown into the lake of fire and sulfur, where the beast and the false prophet already are; they will be tormented day and night for ever and ever.
Then I saw a great white throne and the one who sits on it; from his face the earth and the heaven fled away, and no place was found for them.

And I saw the dead, great and small, standing before the throne. Books were opened, then another book was opened, the book of life; and the dead were judged by what was written in the books, according to their deeds.
The sea gave up its dead; Death and the realm of the dead gave up theirs; and each one was judged according to his deeds.
Then Death and the realm of the dead were thrown into the lake of fire. This is the second death, the lake of fire.
And whoever was not found written in the book of life was thrown into the lake of fire.

titres.titre: A new heaven and a new earth

versets.t: Then I saw a new heaven and a new earth, for the first heaven and the first earth had passed away, and the sea was no more.
And I saw the holy city, the new Jerusalem, coming down from heaven, from God, ready like a bride adorned for her husband.
And I heard, coming from the throne, a loud voice that said: "Behold, the Dwelling of God with men! He will dwell with them, they will be his peoples, and he himself, their God, will be with them.
He will wipe away every tear from their eyes; death will be no more, and there will be no more grief or crying or pain, for the old world has passed away."
And the one who sits on the throne declared: "Behold, I am making all things new." Then he said: "Write, for these words are sure and true."
And he said to me: "It is done. I am the Alpha and the Omega, the beginning and the end. To the one who thirsts I will freely give from the spring of the water of life.
The victor will receive this inheritance; I will be his God, and he will be my son.

But as for the cowards, the unbelieving, the abominable, the murderers, the immoral, the sorcerers, the idolaters and all liars, their portion is in the lake blazing with fire and sulfur: this is the second death."
Then one of the seven angels who held the seven bowls full of the seven last plagues came and said to me: "Come, I will show you the bride, the wife of the Lamb."
He carried me away in the spirit to a great and high mountain, and he showed me the holy city, Jerusalem, coming down from heaven, from God,
resplendent with the glory of God. Its radiance was like a very precious stone, like crystalline jasper.
It had a great and high wall, with twelve gates; at these gates twelve angels, and names inscribed, those of the twelve tribes of the sons of Israel.
Three gates on the east, three gates on the north, three gates on the south and three gates on the west.
The wall of the city had twelve foundations, and on them the twelve names of the twelve apostles of the Lamb.
The one who spoke with me held, as a measure, a golden reed, to measure the city, its gates and its wall.
The city is square: its length equals its width. He measured the city with the reed: twelve thousand stadia; its length, its width and its height are equal.
He measured its wall: one hundred forty-four cubits, by human measure, which is also an angel's measure.
The wall is built of jasper, and the city is of pure gold, like pure crystal.
The foundations of the city wall are adorned with every kind of precious stone: the first foundation is jasper, the second sapphire, the third chalcedony, the fourth emerald,
the fifth sardonyx, the sixth carnelian, the seventh chrysolite, the eighth beryl, the ninth topaz, the tenth chrysoprase, the eleventh jacinth, the twelfth amethyst.
The twelve gates are twelve pearls: each gate is made of a single pearl. The great street of the city is of pure gold, transparent as glass.
I saw no temple in the city, for its temple is the Lord God Almighty, and the Lamb.
The city has no need of the sun or the moon to light it, for the glory of God illumines it, and the Lamb is its lamp.
The nations will walk by its light, and the kings of the earth will bring their splendor into it.
Its gates will never be shut by day, for there will be no night.
The splendor and the wealth of the nations will be brought into it.
Nothing unclean will enter it, nor anyone who commits abomination and falsehood, but only those who are written in the Lamb's book of life.

titres.titre: The river and the tree of life

versets.t: Then the angel showed me a river of the water of life, clear as crystal, flowing from the throne of God and of the Lamb.

In the middle of the great street of the city, and on either side of the river, stands the tree of life, which bears twelve harvests: each month it gives its fruit, and its leaves serve to heal the nations.
There will be no more curse. The throne of God and of the Lamb will be in the city; his servants will serve him,
they will see his face, and his name will be on their foreheads.
There will be no more night; they will need neither the light of a lamp nor the light of the sun, for the Lord God will illumine them, and they will reign for ever and ever.
Then the angel said to me: "These words are sure and true; the Lord, the God of the spirits of the prophets, has sent his angel to show his servants what must soon take place.
Behold, I am coming soon. Blessed is the one who keeps the words of the prophecy of this book."
It is I, John, who heard and saw all this. And when I had heard and seen it, I fell at the feet of the angel who showed it to me, to worship him.
But he said to me: "Do not do that! I am a servant like you, like your brothers the prophets and like those who keep the words of this book. Worship God!"
Then he said to me: "Do not keep secret the words of the prophecy of this book, for the time is near.
Let the unjust still do injustice, let the filthy still be filthy; but let the just still do justice, and let the holy still be holy.
Behold, I am coming soon, and I bring with me the reward, to repay each one according to his deeds.
I am the Alpha and the Omega, the first and the last, the beginning and the end.
Blessed are those who wash their robes: they will have the right to the tree of life and will enter the city by the gates!
Outside are the dogs, the sorcerers, the immoral, the murderers, the idolaters, and everyone who loves and practices falsehood!
I, Jesus, have sent my angel to attest all this to you for the churches. I am the root and the offspring of David, the bright morning star."
The Spirit and the Bride say: "Come!" Let the one who hears also say: "Come!" Let the one who thirsts come; let the one who desires it freely receive the water of life.
I attest to everyone who hears the words of the prophecy of this book: if anyone adds to them, God will add to his lot the plagues described in this book;
and if anyone takes away from the words of the book of this prophecy, God will take away his share of the tree of life and of the holy city, described in this book.
The one who attests all this declares: "Yes, I am coming soon." Amen! Come, Lord Jesus!
May the grace of the Lord Jesus be with all. Amen.
